paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.72% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.05%) and Dow Jones weakest (+0.18%). Brent crude changed -2.09% to 98.22. Gold changed +0.66% to 4,184.2998. Bitcoin changed +0.39% to 86,117.9531. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.311%, a relative move of +0.64%. Among the firms tracked, Santander (+4.04%) and Vale (+2.83%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: McKesson and CD&R near $5bn-plus deal to buy infusion services provider (FT Companies). Acquisition of Option Care Health would be the latest buyout of an undervalued healthcare services company Deals and capital markets: NextEra’s $67bn Dominion takeover faces political backlash in Virginia (FT World). Rising power bills and concerns about monopoly power prompt officials to intervene in deal Central banks and macro: French central bank head warns country at risk of being ‘strangled by interest rates’ (FT Markets). Emmanuel Moulin says France can still reassure bond investors despite ‘serious and worrying’ market moves in recent days Central banks and macro: Trump eases red diesel limits in attempt to quell fuel inflation (FT Markets). US president announces the move during a trip to the agricultural state of Nebraska Geopolitics and trade: Citi to speed up promotion path for junior bankers as hiring war heats up (FT Markets). Length of investment banking analyst programme to be cut to two years to try to stave off poaching of young workers by private equity
